about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a Mobile Developer with over 6 years of experience building high-performance applications using Flutter, Kotlin, and Swift. I specialize in creating scalable, user-centered solutions, following best development practices.
about.paragraph2: I have a proven track record in team leadership and implementing DevSecOps practices to deliver quality software. I've led the development of 4+ cross-platform applications (Android, iOS, Web) and created innovative tools such as Server-Driven UI platforms and libraries for AI-driven development.
about.paragraph3: I'm the creator of the STAC-based Server-Driven UI platform for dynamic widgets and the NPM library cw-method-rdd (Rules Driven Development), a method that establishes development guidelines including clean architecture, SOLID principles, testing strategies, and best practices for AI-driven development.
